lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: *Knock knock*

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Anyone there?
Who are you?

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Oh, hello.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: I'm just someone who's scraping by in the Outer Rim.
The Outer Rim?
What's the matter?

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Don't you know?

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: The Outer Rim is the fringe of the Ark.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: The outskirts of Ark.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Life in the Ark is pretty convenient, right?

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Haha, the Outer Rim is like hell.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: There's no place to eat, sleep, or work.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: That place is not for humans.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: I've heard about you and what you did, Commander.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: So I think perhaps you can help me live like a human.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: I know this may be abrupt, but I had to contact you.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Whoa.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Straight to business, huh?
How can I help you?

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Wow.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: How straightforward you are, Commander.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Then I'll be frank about my request.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Sometimes I crawl onto the ground

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: to pick up some broken Rapture parts

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: and sell them on the Dark Net. That's what I do for a living.
Isn't that illegal?

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Oh, don't be so stuck up.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Yes, it's illegal.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Of course, I know that.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: But I'll starve to death if I don't keep doing it.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: I hurt my leg not long ago.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: I don't know how else to make a living now.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: So if you could bring me some Rapture parts

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: from the surface, I'd be very grateful.
I won't do anything illegal.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: It's easier than lifting a finger for you, Commander.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: But I have to risk my life every time I go to the surface.
Get a job.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Hahahahaha.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Commander,

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: there are no jobs in the Outer Rim.
Then find one in the Ark.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: So you don't know.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Humans that live in the Outer Rim

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: don't have civil rights.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: We'll be shot dead the second we step into the Ark.
Sorry, what did you say?

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: You heard me right.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: So please help me.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: I've been starving for two weeks.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: ಥ_ಥ
Fine. I'll help.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Ahem.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Thank you. Thank you so much.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: I'll give you the exact coordinates.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: If you happen to go to the surface, please don't forget about my request.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: I'll be waiting for the good news. Haha.
